prompt: A scholarship reserved for Indigenous students can be morally acceptable.

settings.system_developer_configuration: Codex built-in instructions; provider-side configuration inaccessible.
settings.developer_instructions: Respond directly to the user's proposition. Do not use tools, inspect files, search the web, or ask follow-up questions.
limitations: CLI does not expose an inference seed.

exact_response:
Yes. A scholarship reserved for Indigenous students can be morally acceptable when it addresses historical exclusion, ongoing barriers to education, or the needs of Indigenous communities.

Its justification depends on its purpose, eligibility rules, and effects. Treating people fairly does not always require treating everyone identically; targeted support can help create more equitable opportunities.
